---
title: "Models & Dynamics"
description: "Specify the dynamical system at each node: equations, parameters, noise, events, and units."
---

Every TVBO simulation starts with a **dynamical system** — the equations that govern a
single node. TVBO ships 39 neural-mass models and lets you declare your own in YAML.
This topic covers writing that specification and everything that shapes how it
integrates.

## Learn

- [Defining dynamical systems](DefineDynamicalSystem.qmd) — write a model from scratch,
  from a damped pendulum to a neural mass.

## Do

- [Events & stimulation](Events.qmd) *(draft)* — threshold events, preset-time events,
  and external stimuli.
- [Noise & stochastic integration](Noise.qmd) — additive and multiplicative noise.
- [Initial conditions](InitialConditions.qmd) — set and resolve starting state.
- [Unit-aware computations](UnitValidation.qmd) — keep a model dimensionally consistent.

## Understand

- [Cross-backend numerical parity](CrossBackendParity.qmd) — why two backends can
  disagree, and the four things that break parity.
